release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob (Build 115).
• Fingerprint security integration: biometric prompt required to open Admin Control, modify retention timeouts, and confirm cleanup.
• Locked timeout configuration preventing accidental taps with one-touch fingerprint unlock.
• Live animated status ticker during broker fetching and real-time purge progress bar with batch percentage.
• Transparent cleanup confirmation showing exact eligible record count (~681) and estimated duration (~2s).
• Smooth count-up animations for broker storage metrics matching native BingoTheme.
